posts.title: The factor that could bring down Anthropic
posts.description: Anthropic's IPO made history, but much of its revenue is paid with venture capital via startups. If end-customer demand arrives later than expected, its long, non-cancelable supplier commitments could squeeze it hard. The post The factor that could bring down Anthropic appeared first on Björn Jeffery .

posts.title: Will Hemnet stay on the stock exchange?
posts.description: Hemnet's share price has fallen steadily since early 2025, and the private equity firm that took it public is buying back in. A buyout may be coming – but Mäklarsamfundet holds the deciding votes. The post Will Hemnet stay on the stock exchange? appeared first on Björn Jeffery .

posts.title: Nvidia is now caught in a political crisis
posts.description: The Nvidia infidelity scandal has quickly turned into a political fight. The chip company is now caught in the crossfire between different parts of the U.S. government – even as it keeps delivering strong results. The post Nvidia is now caught in a political crisis appeared first on Björn Jeffery .
